note: Congregations, community help and events run by congregations in the Mount Washington Valley towns. Service times are given only where a source was opened; many come from third-party directories and are marked for review. Several congregations' own websites could not be opened in this update, so many entries have no service times. No congregation was found in Albany or Hart's Location in the sources opened; that is a gap in this list, not proof there are none. No Muslim, Quaker, Buddhist, Latter-day Saints, Jehovah's Witnesses, Baha'i, Christian Science or Orthodox congregation was found meeting in the nine towns; the nearest found were outside the valley (for example a Latter-day Saints branch in Wolfeboro and Kingdom Halls in Campton and Bath). Listing is in no particular order and implies no endorsement.
